Name: YunGuo Red Panda Farmer
Author: ZongWangxiaoyi
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Replace the player farmer with 云果, a red panda girl — cream face, rust-orange fur, big ears, mint dress and a ring-tailed tail. Every farmer animation is covered: walking, running, tool use, fishing, eating and drinking, sitting on benches, riding, and swimming. The sprite is drawn at the game's native 16×32, with 124 frames split into three layers (body / arms / secondary arms) and an 11-colour palette.

主控角色整只替换为小熊猫少女「云果」：奶油白脸、锈橙色毛、大耳、薄荷绿衣、环纹尾。覆盖全部主控动作：走路、跑步、使用工具、钓鱼、吃喝、坐长椅、骑乘、泳装。按游戏原生 16×32 制作，124 帧分为三层（身体 / 手臂 / 备用手臂），11 色色卡。

This is an unofficial fan-made mod and is not affiliated with or endorsed by ConcernedApe or the developers of Stardew Valley.
本 Mod 为非官方同人作品，与 ConcernedApe 及《星露谷物语》开发者不存在官方合作、授权背书或隶属关系。[/color]


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install SMAPI 4.0 or later.
2. Install Content Patcher 2.0 or later.
3. Unzip the download and drop the RedPandaFarmer folder into Stardew Valley/Mods/.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI.

1. 安装 SMAPI 4.0+。
2. 安装 Content Patcher 2.0+。
3. 解压下载的压缩包，把 RedPandaFarmer 文件夹放进 Stardew Valley/Mods/。
4. 用 SMAPI 启动游戏。[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]• 124 drawn frames covering every farmer animation slot (118/119 are empty in vanilla too).
• Three separate layers — body, arms and secondary arms — so tool swings and carrying items never duplicate hands.
• All 28 tool/weapon swing frames are aligned to the game's own grip points, so tools stay in the hand while swinging.
• Config option HideClothes (default true) hides vanilla shirt / pants / hairstyle / accessory layers; set it to false to keep the dress-up system.
• No save-file changes — delete the folder to uninstall.

• 124 帧实绘，覆盖全部主控动画帧位（118/119 原版也是空的）。
• 身体 / 手臂 / 备用手臂三层分离，挥工具与抱物不会出现重复的手。
• 28 个挥工具 / 挥武器帧的手位已对齐游戏内的工具握点，挥动时工具不再脱手。
• 配置项 HideClothes（默认 true）隐藏原版上衣 / 裤子 / 发型 / 配饰层；设为 false 可保留换装系统。
• 不改存档，删文件夹即卸载。[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]• SMAPI 4.0 or later — https://smapi.io/
• Content Patcher 2.0 or later — https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915

• SMAPI 4.0+ — https://smapi.io/
• Content Patcher 2.0+ — https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to Pathoschild for SMAPI and Content Patcher, and to the Stardew Valley Wiki modding documentation for the sprite and animation references.

感谢 Pathoschild 的 SMAPI 与 Content Patcher，以及 Stardew Valley Wiki 的 Mod 制作文档（精灵图与动画帧参考）。



[b][i]Known limitations 已知限制[/i][/b]
────────────────────────
• No dialogue portrait — the vanilla farmer has no portrait asset, so 云果 does not appear in dialogue boxes.
• When wearing a hat, the hat layer covers the ears completely. Hats are drawn above the character, so this is occlusion, not clipping.
• Fixed look — the skin / eye / hair colour sliders in character creation have no effect.
• For downward-facing frames the hands are baked into the body layer, because the engine draws the arm layer behind the body when facing down.
• Conflicts with any other mod that replaces Characters/Farmer/*.

• 没有对话立绘 —— 原版主控本身没有肖像文件，所以对话框里不会出现云果。
• 戴帽子时耳朵会被帽子完全盖住：帽子层画在角色之上，这是遮挡，不是穿模。
• 固定形象：捏人界面的肤色 / 瞳色 / 发色不生效。
• 朝下方向的手画在身体层里（引擎朝下时把手臂层画在身体后面）。
• 与任何替换 Characters/Farmer/* 的 Mod 冲突。

Generative AI Disclosure

The character sprite artwork in this mod was created using generative AI tools under the author's direction. The author provided the character design requirements, sprite specifications, animation frame requirements, and visual feedback, and iteratively reviewed and revised the generated artwork before integrating it into the mod.

The author also carried out sprite-sheet integration, proportion and animation checks, and in-game testing to improve the consistency and usability of the final result.

AI was used as part of the artwork creation process. This disclosure is provided for transparency regarding the production of the mod's visual assets.

生成式 AI 使用声明

本 Mod 中的角色精灵图使用生成式 AI 工具辅助制作，并由作者主导设计方向。作者提供了角色设计要求、精灵图规格、动作帧需求及视觉反馈，并通过多轮审查与订正，对生成的美术素材进行调整后整合至 Mod 中。

作者还进行了图集整合、角色比例与动作表现检查，以及游戏内实机测试，以提高最终素材的一致性和实际使用效果。

AI 参与了本 Mod 的美术创作过程。我们在此如实披露相关制作方式，以便玩家了解本 Mod 视觉素材的创作来源。[/color]
